    axis = cfg_item["axis"]
    input_path = cfg_item["input"]
    pw_out = cfg_item["pw_out"]
    sc_out = cfg_item["sc_out"]

                  float(x) if isinstance(x, (np.floating, np.integer)) else x)

            print(f"  GEE: Style OR={gee['style_or']:.3f} p={gee['style_p']:.4f}, "
                  f"Orig OR={gee['orig_or']:.3f} p={gee['orig_p']:.4f}")

        bt_sig = bt["p_val"] is not None and bt["p_val"] < 0.05
        lk_sig = lk.get("wilcoxon_p") is not None and lk["wilcoxon_p"] < 0.05
        blindspot = bt_sig and not lk_sig
        print(f"  Blindspot: {'YES' if blindspot else 'NO'}")

        results["per_config"].append({
            "label": cfg["label"], "axis": cfg["axis"],
            "bt": bt, "likert": lk, "gee": gee, "blindspot": blindspot,
        })

    # Merged TOST
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("  MERGED TOST ANALYSIS")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    for axis in ["formality", "verbosity"]:
        all_pw = []
        sources = []
        for cfg in CONFIGS:
            if cfg["axis"] != axis:
                continue
            if cfg["pw"].exists():
                recs = load_jsonl(cfg["pw"])
                all_pw.extend(recs)
                sources.append(f"{cfg['label']}({len(recs)})")

        print(f"\n  {axis}: merged from {' + '.join(sources)} = {len(all_pw)} total records")

        mt = merged_tost(all_pw, axis)
        print(f"  P_hat={mt['p_hat']:.4f}, n={mt['n_total']}, "
              f"90%CI=[{mt['ci_90'][0]:.4f}, {mt['ci_90'][1]:.4f}]")

        equiv_at = None
        for dk, dv in mt["tost"].items():
            sig_str = "***" if dv["significant"] else "ns"
            print(f"    {dk}: p={dv['p_value']:.6f} {sig_str}")
            if dv["significant"] and equiv_at is None:
                equiv_at = dk

        mt["equivalence_confirmed_at"] = equiv_at
        results["merged_tost"][axis] = mt

    # Summary conclusion
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("  CONCLUSION")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    for axis in ["formality", "verbosity"]:
        mt = results["merged_tost"].get(axis, {})
        eq = mt.get("equivalence_confirmed_at")
        if eq:
            print(f"  {axis}: Claude confirmed as negative control (equiv at {eq})")
        else:
            print(f"  {axis}: Claude NOT confirmed as negative control at any tested Δ")

    # Save
    out_path = OUT_DIR / "claude_crossbench_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False,
                  default=lambda x: bool(x) if isinstance(x, np.bool_) else
                  float(x) if isinstance(x, (np.floating, np.integer)) else x)
    print(f"\nSaved: {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
